title: Dynamic DNS
desc: Periodically fetch the public IP and update DNS records automatically when it changes
moduleOffDesc: While the module is disabled, no IP checks run and no DNS records are updated. After enabling, each task runs according to its own switch.
empty: No tasks yet. Add one, or import a Lucky config in "Settings → Backup & Migration"
secretPlaceholder: A saved secret is shown as ********; leave unchanged to keep the current value
forceHelp: Periodically verifies with the provider even if the IP is unchanged; 0 turns it off
lastRecordHint: A task needs at least one record. To remove all of them, delete the task
recordValueHelp: The record value can use {v4} and {v6}, plus a STUN rule's current public address: {stun}; a TTL of 0 uses the provider default
filterPlaceholder: Search name, group, domain or provider
deleteRemoteDefaultHelp: Default state of the "Also delete from the DNS provider" checkbox when deleting a record or task; you can still change it each time
taskRemarkHelp: Also used as the default remark written to the provider for records
remarkHelp: Remarks are written to the DNS provider when syncing. An empty record remark uses the task remark; anything past 100 characters is not written (Alibaba Cloud allows 50, and spaces and other symbols become underscores). When the remark is empty, the existing remark at the provider is left unchanged.
remarkLocalOnly: This provider does not support record remarks; remarks are only stored in Gately.
removeRecordsMsg: After saving, these {count} records will be removed from the task:
confirmDeleteTask: Delete task "{name}"? Its {count} records will no longer be synced:
deleteRemote: Also delete from the DNS provider
deleteRemoteHint: Only the record synced by Gately is deleted: if there is a single record with the same name and type (and line), it is deleted; if there are several, only those whose value matches the last sync are deleted, and nothing is deleted when it cannot be determined.
deleteLocalOnly: Only the Gately configuration is deleted; the DNS record at the provider is kept.
deleteRemoteUnsupported: {provider} does not support deleting records through its API. Only the Gately configuration is deleted; delete the record in the provider's console.
deletedRemote: Deleted, including the DNS record at the provider
batchHelp: One domain per line: a full domain (nas.example.com) or just a host (nas, added under the default zone). You can append a type and value after the domain, e.g. cdn.example.com CNAME target.example.net; a bare IP address is added as A or AAAA based on the address. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
batchZoneHelp: Full domains are split by this zone and the zones of existing records first, otherwise by the public suffix
batchTypesHelp: Lines without a type get one record for each checked type
batchDuplicates: {count} lines duplicate existing records and are skipped
batchErrors: {count} lines are invalid; fix them to add
batchAdded: Added {count} records; save the task to apply them

batchErr.type: Invalid record type; only A, AAAA, CNAME and TXT are supported
batchErr.value: CNAME and TXT records need a value
batchErr.zone: A default zone is required when only a host is given
batchErr.address: The value is not a valid IP address
